newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee Land closes PG Design purchase.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee Land closes PG Design purchase.

text.p: Milwaukee Land Co on Monday said it closed its purchase of PG Design Electronics Inc's assets, subject to certain liabilities.
The purchase price was $15 million plus the assumption of bank debt of about $1.2 million, said Milwaukee Land, which previously announced the purchase agreement.
PG Design Electronics is a contract designer and manufacturer of printed circuit-board assemblies and products for computer and computer products manufacturers.
Milwaukee Land is a closed-end management investment company. It is the general partner of Heartland Partners LP, a master limited partnership.
